reasoning_details.text:
**Estimating Effort for Feature**

I'm currently focused on determining the effort required for the WebSocket source user story. My analysis of the specification is underway, and I'm breaking down the requirements to arrive at a solid estimate.

**Defining Module Strategies**

I'm now concentrating on outlining the specific modules, starting with the WebSocket and AWS source integrations. I'm also beginning to sketch out the Cassandra, AWS, HAWQ, and SOLR sink modules, alongside defining robust error handling strategies.

**Designing Integration Modules**

My focus has shifted to the technical design for various integrations. I've detailed the use of AWS SDK v2 and Spring Integration for AWS, alongside Spring Data Cassandra and Spring Data Solr. I'm also planning Avro/Parquet payloads for HAWQ, and a core error channel mechanism with custom interceptors.

**Developing Source Modules**

My focus is now on the core development for the WebSocket and AWS source modules, including implementing their respective inbound adapters and auto-configurations, alongside comprehensive testing.

technical_and_design_decisions: Modules will be implemented as standard Spring Integration / Spring Cloud Stream source and sink components leveraging Spring Boot 3.x and Java 17+.
AWS components (U2, U4) will utilize the Spring Integration AWS extension and AWS SDK for S3 and SES operations.
Cassandra Sink (U3) will utilize Datastax Java Driver and Spring Data Cassandra abstractions for high-throughput batch writes.
HAWQ Sink (U5) will format data segments into Avro/Parquet schemas before writing to the HAWQ PXF REST/file integration endpoint.
Solr Sink (U6) will use SolrJ client library to handle batch indexing and document posting.

Error Channel routing (U7) will be implemented as a global interceptor and error handler within the messaging context, extracting nested root causes, wrapping errors into standard exception hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException), and forwarding to specified error channel topics.
assumptions: Development environment includes local Docker/Testcontainers capabilities to run Cassandra, Solr, HAWQ, and AWS LocalStack for integration testing.
A CI/CD pipeline and standard repository structure exist and are configured for Spring project modules.
User Story U8 requires test suite implementation and validation only, as state preservation logic is already implemented in the core runtime.
The software increment is developed by a single experienced Spring framework developer.

activities.activity_description: Analyze story requirements, design module configuration properties, establish standard base interfaces for sources/sinks, and define the error handling architecture.
Develop WebSocket inbound channel adapter wrapper, auto-configuration classes, handshake handlers, payload converters, and unit/integration tests.
Implement S3 event ingest and SES inbound adapters using Spring Integration AWS extension, auto-configuration properties, and integration tests.
Develop Cassandra outbound channel adapter with support for high-velocity batch inserts, dynamic CQL mapping, connection tuning, and tests.
Develop S3 outbound sink module supporting direct file/stream uploads, multipart upload handling, configuration options, and integration tests.
Implement HAWQ sink module with Avro and Parquet serialization layers, PXF client integration, batch staging, and integration tests.
Develop Apache Solr outbound sink utilizing SolrJ for batch indexing, full-text document mapping, commit management, and tests.

activities.activity_name: Explicit Error Channel & Exception Hierarchy Implementation (U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement error channel configuration capabilities, exception hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException), 'Caused by' root cause extractor, and payload staging router.
Construct automated end-to-end test scenarios adding and removing modules dynamically to validate data partition state preservation.
Perform overall module cross-testing, write configuration guides, document sample applications, and finalize release packaging.
